title: HeatmapRequest
description: Model-to-cloud deviation request (F-48, v0.3 §7; spec §9 rule 6). Not a command: it changes nothing. The service reads the points of `selection` through the points port, keeps those within heatmapBufferM of the nearest face polygon, and the kernel returns a heatmap-result (D-3D22-6). The threshold has no server default (D-3D22-2).
$comment: D-3D22-7. [P] Member names. Wire binding (route, auth) is 3D-23's.

selection.description: Region of the cloud to compare, LOCAL frame.

faceIds.description: Optional: report only these faces; points are still assigned to their nearest face of the whole model (D-3D22-6).

thresholdM.description: Distance beyond which a point counts in summary.shareBeyondThreshold; required, no default (D-3D22-2, Q-24).
